name.ja: 30MM オプションパーツセット ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 06
name.en: 30MM OPTION PARTS SET ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 06

ja: 『ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化。
シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、双刃ブレードが特徴的なレーザースライサーを含めた武器群をセットで商品化。
• 武器の内容は「MA-E-211 SAMPU」「Vvc-774LS」「Vvc-703PM」「MA-J-200 RANSETSU-RF」。
• 装備する際に左右で形状が変わる武装は再現用のパーツがそれぞれ付属し、選択式で組み立てが可能。
• 「Vvc-774LS」の展開状態を再現可能な差し替えパーツが付属。
• 腕武器を肩部へ装備可能にする左右の「ウェポンハンガー」が付属。
en: "ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON " items are commercialized in the " 30 MINUTES MISSIONS" series.
Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," we have commercialized a set of weapons, including a laser slicer with a distinctive double-edged blade.
• The contents of the weapons are "MA-E-211 SAMPU ", " Vvc-774LS ", " Vvc-703PM ", and " MA-J-200 RANSETSU-RF".
• Weapons that change shape on the left and right when equipped come with parts for reproduction, and can be assembled selectively.
• Replacement parts that can reproduce the unfolded state of "Vvc-774LS" are included.
• Comes with left and right "Weapon hangers" that allow arm weapons to be mounted on the shoulders.

ja: ウェポンハンガー（左右）×1式
en: Weapon hanger (left and right) x 1 set
